content.title: Eos Energy CEO discusses battery maker's Pennsylvania investment
content.description:
Eos Energy Enterprises (EOSE) stock was lifted in Tuesday trading after the energy storage developer announced it will invest more than $350 million into expanding its manufacturing operations in the state of Pennsylvania. This comes as part of Eos Energy's push — dubbed Project AMAZE (American Made Zinc Energy) — to make Pennsylvania a national energy hub as the company relocates its headquarters to Pittsburgh.

Eos Energy CEO Joe Mastrangelo speaks with Market Domination's Josh Lipton about its expansion plans, the company's other partnerships with Talen Energy (TLN) and MN8 Energy, and why he views the plan as a solid investment for Pennsylvania and a means to bolster production ahead of growing AI data center demand.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.
